This is the core region-inference engine that owns opaque-type and type-test handling during borrow checking. Even if the actual bad acceptance happens in `opaque_types.rs`, region inference is the next most likely place where the wrong opaque subject or region relation would be accepted.

This file orchestrates the overall NLL pipeline, including region rewriting, type checking, region inference, and opaque-type solution assembly. It is less direct than the opaque-specific modules, but still a plausible integration point for the regression.
